DOMAIN 1: CLIENT CRYPTOGRAPHIC BOUNDARY (BROWSER)
• Trust Classification: Zero-Knowledge Client Perimeter

• Pinned OpenPGP.js v6 WebCrypto / Wasm Curve25519 (X25519 / Ed25519)

DOMAIN 4: OBJECT STORAGE BOUNDARY (CLOUDFLARE R2)
• Trust Classification: Encrypted Binary Artifact Perimeter

• Direct client-to-R2 upload/download via 15-minute presigned URLs
• Client-side encrypted RFC 9580 SEIPDv2 binary envelopes (SSE-R2 AES-256 at rest)
• Zero server byte proxying (prevents serverless memory exhaustion)
